metadata.title: Density of length ratios on Teichmüller space
metadata.abstract: We study length ratios of simple closed geodesics on finite-type hyperbolic surfaces of positive genus. We allow cusps and fix the geodesic boundary lengths. Let $d$ be the dimension of the corresponding Teichmüller space $\mathcal{T}_{\mathbf{L}}(S)$. We prove that for every positive vector $(r_0,\ldots,r_d)$, the set of surfaces carrying $d+1$ distinct essential interior simple closed geodesics with lengths proportional to this vector is dense in $\mathcal{T}_{\mathbf{L}}(S)$. In particular, one-holed tori with three distinct simple closed geodesics of equal length are dense. The proof uses high powers of Dehn twists, asymptotics of length differentials, and the Brouwer fixed-point theorem.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 对正亏格有限型双曲曲面，在固定测地边界长度的 Teichmüller 空间中，实现任意给定 d+1 条简单闭测地线长度比例的曲面集合稠密。
analysis.breakthrough: 将多条曲线的精确比例关系与 Teichmüller 空间的稠密性联系起来。
analysis.limitations: 曲线可随曲面变化；并非预先固定 d+1 个同伦类就能在稠密集中满足比例。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 协助检查证明及文字校对；第5页 A_I 等数学记号命中不作为独立证据。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 协助检查证明及文字校对；第5页 A_I 等数学记号命中不作为独立证据。

analysis.priorityReason: 长度谱几何的精确稠密现象，需注意量词次序。
